description: The mirror image: ar is the fallback locale and owns the only Article, so an en request is served by an RTL donor. The default RTL_LOCALES must isolate the interpolated name AND the resolver must be handed ar. Together with resolver-locale-rtl-request-ltr-donor this pins, in BOTH directions, that bidi isolation and the resolver locale are decided by the same supplying locale, and — via the per-call NONE override — that changing the isolation mode does not move that locale.
